✨ BEGINNER SKINCARE ROUTINE FOR ACNE-PRONE SKIN

☀️ MORNING ROUTINE

1. Gentle face wash
2. 5% Niacinamide serum
3. Moisturiser
4. Sunscreen SPF 30–50

🌙 NIGHT ROUTINE

Salicylic Acid Nights (Start 1–2 times a week)

1. Gentle face wash
2. Salicylic acid serum (apply as directed)
3. Moisturiser

Other Nights

1. Gentle face wash
2. Niacinamide serum (optional)
3. Moisturiser

🤍 IMPORTANT TIPS
• Start with 5% niacinamide and introduce one serum at a time.
• Don’t use salicylic acid every night when you’re a beginner.
• Avoid combining salicylic acid with other exfoliating acids or retinol initially.
• If you experience burning, redness, or peeling, stop the active products and use only a gentle cleanser, moisturiser, and sunscreen until your skin settles.
• Patch-test new products before applying them to your face.

✨ REMEMBER: These serums may help manage acne, oiliness, and clogged pores, but they cannot guarantee completely clear skin. Consistency and a healthy skin barrier matter!

MY CURLY HAIR RESET ROUTINE | From Dry & Frizzy to Defined Curls!MY CURL RESET ROUTINE, STEP BY STEP:

1. Overnight Hair Oiling (Champi) 
I started by applying Nidhi’s Grandma Secret Hair Oil to my scalp and cold-pressed coconut oil generously along my hair lengths. I massaged my scalp well, followed by 15 minutes of heat treatment using a heat cap. Once done, I gently detangled my hair with a detangling comb, braided it, and left the oils on overnight ​⁠ . @grandmaasecret 

2. Clarifying Shampoo 
The next morning, I washed my hair with a strong clarifying shampoo to remove all the oil, dirt, and buildup. Make sure you cleanse your scalp and hair thoroughly so no oily residue is left behind before moving on to the next step. 

3. Bond Repair Hair Mask 
After shampooing, I applied a bond repair hair mask to my hair lengths, making sure to avoid my scalp. I left it on for 30 minutes, including 20 minutes of heat treatment, to give my curls some extra care. ​⁠ @letscurlupdotcom 

4. Leave-In Conditioner 
After rinsing off the mask, I applied a lightweight leave-in conditioner generously to my hair lengths. I used a wide-tooth comb to distribute the product evenly through my hair. ​⁠ 

5. Brush Styling & Gel 
Next, I brush-styled my curls using my curl styling brush and scrunched in a gel to help define my curls and hold their shape.

6. Drying & Diffusing 
I let my hair air-dry for around 10–20 minutes before using a diffuser to finish drying my curls and reveal the final results!

❤️SAVE THIS ROUTINE for the days when your curls need a little extra TLC!

Remember, this is an occasional reset routine for when my hair feels extra dry and needs more care, not something I do every wash day.
